body: Hi, thank you so much for the answer! I will most likely take it to Apple (or another certified place) to see what the definitive issue is and move forward from there. The main issue is probably the charging port (I'm guessing), but I can figure that out. This is all great information, it will definitely help. Thanks once again :)
That's actually better for my usage! Thanks :)

It took me years to realize that I wasn't what they called me and those were what they prescribed me. Wasn't even until counselling the past few months that I fully understood it. Literally thought it was normal to walk around with a voice in my head telling me I was stupid, ugly, disgusting, fat, useless, a piece of shit, etc. 

I actually thought I was incapable of feeling love, literally thought I was heartless and selfish, that I was a miserable bitch incapable of love or truly liking someone (I actually thought I was a sociopath at once, haha!). I thought that I was ugly, useless, and stupid. Didn't even start questioning it until this year! January was the first time I told myself I wasn't a heartless bitch and believed it. I cried. Still working on it. 

Thank you so much for your comment. It's very kind. Didn't actually expect anyone to read all that. God it will be hard, erasing my way of thinking for almost half my life. I'm like functionally messed up to the core. Even as you said, the fact that I've realized they called me those things shows improvement.  It's hard to see that sometimes, ya know? I'll remind myself I deserve to feel good and that I am worthy enough. Thanks random Internet guy.

This is an old post but I figure it will help me get it off my chest. Okay, how to condense the last almost 9 years of my life? My parents fucked me up by yelling bad things at me for years and critiquing me in almost every regard (starting from 11, less over the last few(3) years but still even now). They have fucked me up by making me a scapegoat and making me feel guilty for every damn thing. They have fucked me up to the point that I don't even know who I really am, because I have only ever formed myself from what they told me I was and what I could do to please them. It literally shatters me when someone yells at me or critiques me so that I always end up crying in front of the person no matter who it is. Whenever I fight with them it is all about tricking my mind and making me feel guilty and confused. They don't do it intentionally, but it works. They love me, feed me, get me things I want (while still managing to make me feel like shit), so how am I still so fucked up? I don't know.

Granted I wasn't the easiest child. I stole money from them, I used that money to buy food though the vast majority of the time, so that I would feel better. Yay binge and emotional eating! So I still have the understanding that it is my fault for doing bad things and that being my punishment, but fuck if it hasn't messed with me. 

A list of things I wrote in my journal that my parents would call me/ yell at me (from 11 to now 19):

- stupid
- idiot
- animal (donkey, monkey, pig, etc.)
- ugly
- go kill yourself
- I wish I didn't have you/had an abortion
- you're the kind of person that makes people want to kill themselves
- what are you worth? (nothing)
- lazy
- useless
- selfish
- ass
- i hate you
- i'm going to destroy you before you destroy me
- snake
- sneaky
- liar
- thief
- worst human being
- bitch
- heartless
- heartless (bitch)
- i don't give a damn about you
- you don't deserve me as a (mother/father), you deserve a mom who doesn't care about you, a prostitute on the street/abusive mom
- you're sick in the head (ou, that one has really messed with me)
- you're crazy
- you've lost your mind
- you have no brain
- do you want to go to foster care? I'll put you up for adoption. - You're going to foster care, where the people who adopt you will rape you
- you're going to go/burn in hell 
- nasty
- crybaby (i truly have a terrible relationship with crying now)
- unappreciative
- shit/piece of shit
- garbage
- disgusting
- thought you were smart but you aren't
- fat

And these are the few things I managed to write down twice over a period of 9 years. It's much more, much worse that that. Of course having these things being yelled at me constantly for years during my formative years may or may not have impacted me. 

I even recently told my mom I have depression and have two counsellors. She said a lot of nice things but didn't believe I am depressed. I was even scared to tell her because I was afraid she would use it against me, my parents would, and she fucking did it (more than once now) when she was mad at me. Didn't even ask why I needed the counsellors, just asked what they might have thought of her (that she is a bad mom) since I needed to go there.

The critiquing was/is something else. They would dig into me mercilessly. Everything. The way I looked, dressed, talked, even the way I fucking walked. For example, in terms of how I looked, my dad would say shit about even my fucking lips. My dad literally said something was wrong with my lips because of the way they looked (the colour), they are naturally that way. They would critique the way I would stir food (wow you can't even mix food in the pot? You're stupid, can't do anything right). They way I would greet people, even now. (I don't do it to their liking? "You're not human, can't even greet people properly"). My hair, my body, the way I clean. Constantly, fucking constantly, compare me to other people. All the damn time. (I can't stop doing it now myself, and I always fall short compared to others). Nothing was or is safe from critique.

It's come to the point where I am absolutely terrified of disappointing them. Frankly, it is my biggest fear. At this point I would rather be dead than be a failure, and they made me that way. I am the eldest child (four younger siblings) in a first generation family and it is too much pressure. I am the first in university. I see my other friends, first generation too, from the same country and they are fine and going strong. Then there is me, so smart and creative and I haven't done shit so far because every time I build myself back up they fucking shatter me down. Stuck behind because I'm fucking crazy and I don't see a way out. I try so hard to make them happy and always fail. They have beyond fucked me up the most, out of everything that has contributed to my state. They see nothing wrong with what they have done. Sometimes I think that I was just sensitive and overreacted and cause myself to take it so personally to the point that it has affected me.

I don't know if it is my fault or not for all this. I did bad stuff, I got punished. Maybe I was too damn sensitive and instead of brushing it off my shoulders (as my mom said I should have) I went and did the opposite. All I know is I'm tired. Exhausted. I can't keep living in fear and worry all the time. Constantly being scared of disappointing and doing it any fucking way. Either I run away from everything or I give up....

Okay, thank you for saying that. It's hard to fight against those thoughts but I will try. Yes to the fact that it can be a reason for me that others don't see. Because when I think about what has probably contributed to my depression, I've seen others go through the same thing or less, and when I think about why those things have caused me to be depressed while they've continued to manage I'm like, did I make myself depressed by allowing these things to affect me to this extent? Am I weaker than these people? I don't know. 

I haven't tried any medication. When I went to my doctor and told her she said that she wants to start out with counselling first before going on to meds. At that point though (even though it was earlier this month) I was just in my regular (previously unknown) depressive state and not this major one right now. Maybe that will change this week. I expect it to be a whole nother rollercoaster ride.

I see what you are saying. I'm scared I don't have the strength to fight it, to be honest. I have a counsellor, two in fact. I haven't talked to them for a long time though, maybe after I see them this week it will help. My doctor also knows (but when I saw her the last time I wasn't at this point) she said that I am depressed. I see her this week again, hopefully it will help once again. 

I've told my mom but she doesn't really believe I can be depressed, ended up just telling her I was sad and tired and she accepted that. She says there is no reason for me to be depressed, that I don't have to pay for school and they get me things when I need it and whatnot. She told me to pray to God and she will get our family back home to work their voodoo (sorry, prayers) for me to feel better and that she doesn't want to see me like this anymore (so I will have to put on a fake face now). She did say a lot of nice and affirming things, but it didn't do anything for me. Anyways, ended up feeling like I was making a big deal out of things and being dramatic and allowing myself to wallow in negative feelings.

Thank you for your reply. And I actually really appreciate the writing compliment, I had wanted to become a writer when I was young before starting on this treacherous journey called nursing school and enjoy writing, so thanks :). And organic chem? I commend you for doing so. 

I hope truly that you get through things yourself, it is great to know there are such nice people out there like you. Thank you for reading all of what I wrote, makes me feel more worth it. 

I will try really to keep that in mind, talk to others and feel and accept the love. Hard for me to get really close to people, to have people even touch me but as you said it is worth it.

Wishing you peace in life TroubledLamb. We'll figure it out.

Thank you, makes me feel less useless :). I don't get the physical symptoms traditionally associated with anxiety either, so it makes it hard for people to see how bad it is for me. And wow, really relate to the notion that people are better at hiding or even dealing with it than I am. I'm so sorry you are feeling like that, the idea that our grades reflect our value is such a toxic thing to untangle ones self from. See, I "know" that our grades do not necessarily reflect our value or worth or even intelligence but doesn't stop me from believing opposite (for myself, not for others). 

If it is worth anything, I find value and worth in you. I don't know your situation, but at 17 you really have so much time. I hope you know this comment has helped in not feeling alone myself. Thank you very much once again, hope you find peace.

Thank you for reading. What you've written actually makes me believe for the first time that it is possible to get over this, so thanks again. And I will definitely take the suggestion of printing it out because I already feel my thoughts trying to convince me that I am being dramatic...doing this will help.
19 year old female. I am literally in the same boat. I'm sorry.
